hints.title: Independent Column Evaluation
hints.text: Check each column index independently from left to right.

hints.title: Row-Wise Monotonicity Check
hints.text: For a given column, verify whether characters are non-decreasing as you move down the rows. If any adjacent row pair is out of order, increment the deletion count.

hints.title: Early Termination Column Deletion
hints.text: Loop through column index col from 0 to len(strs[0]) - 1. Loop through row index row from 1 to len(strs) - 1. If strs[row][col] < strs[row - 1][col], add 1 to answer and break inner loop.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying subsets of columns is unnecessary because each column decision is completely independent of the others.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inspecting each character once in grid order uses strictly constant extra memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that columns do not interact, allowing an immediate early-exit inner loop per column.
complexity.notes: Lexicographical order on single characters matches ASCII comparison.
